status: candidate contract; independent corrected-commit review required
input_format: Existing native learning ZIP, library/library.json; no new archive format or rewrite of historical ZIPs
semantic_gates: Every alias source_work_id equals the enclosing record ID
No alias key is owned by two source IDs
Stored and recomputed keys both occur in aliases
Publisher key matches the work-ID/edition-ID formula
Every immutable body hash and all input learning fields match
Runtime local ID check precedes alias reuse

identity.source_work_id: String(text.corpus.byehuda_id); required, unique within a release

recomputed_canonical_key.algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify({v:1,sourceText,ttsProfile:null,tableModelMeta}) in this property order
recomputed_canonical_key.sourceText: String(text.source_text || '').replace CRLF and CR with LF, then trim
recomputed_canonical_key.mismatch_policy: Keep stored and recomputed values as same-work aliases; do not merge another work or silently repair input. Historical exception 28026 is explicit.

identity.learning_edition_id: SHA-256 of the whitelisted normalized publication text before its final text_key/text_id/edition_id are added; build-learning-release.py is the producer
identity.aliases: sorted unique union of verified stored_archive_key, recomputed_canonical_key and previous published keys for the SAME source_work_id
identity.ownership_gate: An alias belonging to more than one source work ID blocks the build. The reader checks local source_meta_json.corpus.byehuda_id before reusing any alias. A conflicting publisher key fails closed.

public_metadata_policy: Whitelist source facts and sanitized machine provenance. No operational ledger, raw prompt, recovery capsule, private path, credentials or learner annotations.

learner_boundary.default_open: Reuse a proven same-work existing local copy, display its actual row count, and offer the publisher edition separately. Cold arrival offers the existing resume without replaying a progress write.
learner_boundary.separate_edition: Only the explicit separate-edition action imports the publisher key when a valid earlier local edition exists; skip semantics and no canon_version

release_boundary.body: works/<source_work_id>-<first 32 SHA-256 body hex characters>.json; full hash verified; numeric old bodies retained
release_boundary.cold_routes: SSR and sitemap resolve the same sealed current edition as the card, checking body hash/ID/key/row count
release_boundary.activation: Independent exact-commit GO, fresh same-manifest capacity gate, sealed immutable upload and every GET hash verification while catalog 7 stays active, then CI and atomic image activation
release_boundary.completion: Actual production version, manifest, hashes, health and UI readback; local gates alone are insufficient

fixture_scope: Exact work records selected from freshly SHA/CRC-verified real learning ZIPs, native local import, actual card Read handler, reload, explicit new-edition opt-in, repeated reload in disposable OPFS. Recomputed/foreign cases deliberately vary one key/identity. Whole-archive import throughput and owner profiles are not claimed.
